comparison.objective: Free an entangled deformable tote strap and lower a loaded tote from a high shelf without dislodging a rake or losing contents; candidate adjusts and validates a rigid robot-axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Pr-295 tests deformable-entanglement reasoning, strap manipulation, high-shelf bimanual load handling, and careful lowering. The candidate tests rigid recessed-tool alignment, counterholding, fine rotary adjustment, force-limited relocking, guarded control actuation, and iterative commissioning.
comparison.success_condition: Pr-295 requires the rake to remain on the shelf, the tote released on the table, and up to four contents retained; its specification has no explicit strap-damage or tote-impact limits. The candidate instead requires two safe repeatable impact cycles, no bottoming/hard-stop/rebound/overload, and measured post-lock setting retention.
comparison.reason: The deformable disentanglement and loaded-object recovery outcome is meaningfully different from rigid mechanical adjustment and dynamic stop validation; bimanual coordination alone is insufficient evidence of overlap.
